handPatches.note: Mo Chit (N8) appended by hand, not by a re-fetch: the pinned relation 444651 still does not contain it, so it arrives via the registry osm.extraStationNodeIds mechanism. Placed where fetchBranch would place an explicitly-named node (after every relation member, i.e. last). Everything else in this file, including all track geometry, is still the `generated` fetch verbatim — so a diff against a fresh fetch that touches anything else is upstream OSM drift, not this patch.
rollingStock added per line from tools/lines.config.mjs without a re-fetch (tools/patch-rolling-stock.mjs); geometry and stations untouched
